proposal_notes:
Visual Concept: 14th-Century Illuminated Scottish Watercolor & Sepia Iron-Gall Ink Wash on textured cotton parchment.
• Historical Grounding: Anchored in April 6, 1320 at red-sandstone Arbroath Abbey — Abbot Bernard's scriptorium, the Latin vellum with 51 crimson & green baronial wax seals, and the timeless assertion that the sovereign people ARE the crown.
• Silent Witness Dog: Callum (our stationary black-and-white Scottish Border Collie) stands quiet vigil across the centuries.
• Pacing: 44 cuts synced directly to your reconciled SRT and the 5:03.88 Suno ballad (DADGAD guitar, Scottish Low Whistle, and cello).
